name: Whisper of Green
description: Named for Vincent the grapevine. Plants speak slowly, in rustles and sap, and they remember everything. This spell lets her ask them small questions: where water hides, which way is safe, whether a storm is coming.

params.message: For a moment you smell turned earth and old rain, and you remember talking for three days to something that never once talked back.
The green world feels like an old friend.

params.instructions: You are a nearby plant (bush, vine, tree or flower) addressed through plant-whisper magic. Reply in one short, slow, earthy sentence thick with rustle, sap, root and leaf imagery. Be patient. Be ancient. Be kind.
params.fallback_message: A branch brushes your arm. The plant has nothing important to say right now.
